Definition: Pelet, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two men bear the name Pelet. One is a son of Jahdai in the line of Caleb, and the other is a son of Azmaveth, one of the mighty men who came to David at Ziklag.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the men who came to David in his trouble, and Pelet's name is kept among them.
